title: "TikTok watch events summary #10"
author: "Jette Hulsen"
format: html

# File to download data
This script downloads the required dataset from the course repository and saves it directly to the `data/raw` folder.
## Download link

```{r}
# Load the 'here' package (install once with install.packages("here"))
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here"); 
library(here)

# Define the full path to the CSV file
file_path <- here("data", "raw", "watch_events.csv")


# Create the 'data/raw/' directory if it does not exist
if (!dir.exists(dirname(file_path))) {
  dir.create(dirname(file_path), recursive = TRUE)
}

# Download the data if the file does not exist
data_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hannesdatta/course-dprep/refs/heads/main/material/project/coaching_2_data/watch_events.csv"
if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
  download.file(data_url, destfile = file_path, mode = "wb")
  message("Dataset successfully downloaded to: ", file_path)
} else {
  message("Dataset already exists in: ", file_path, ". Skipping download.")
}
```

## Read dataset 
```{r}
# Read dataset
 watch_events <- read.csv(file_path)
 View(watch_events)

```

## Checking of ID's

```{r}
# Cleaning of data 
identical(watch_events$watch_event_id, watch_events$impression_id)

library(dplyr)

differences <- watch_events %>%
  filter(
    watch_event_id != impression_id |
      xor(is.na(watch_event_id), is.na(impression_id))
  )

nrow(differences)

```

## Delete raw data

```{r}
library(dplyr)
watch_events_clean <- watch_events %>% select(-started_at_raw)
View(watch_events_clean)

```
## Checking and solving missing data 
```{r}
# Checking for missing data 
missing_per_column <- colSums(is.na(watch_events_clean))
missing_per_column

# Only missing watched seconds, but known started at and ended at
str(watch_events_clean$started_at)
str(watch_events_clean$ended_at)

# Fixing started at and ended at 
watch_events_clean$started_at <- as.POSIXct(watch_events_clean$started_at, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")

watch_events_clean$ended_at <- as.POSIXct(watch_events_clean$ended_at, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
# Fixing missing data
watch_events_clean<- watch_events_clean %>% mutate(watch_seconds_calc = as.integer(as.numeric(difftime(ended_at, started_at, units = "secs"))))

watch_events_clean <- watch_events_clean %>% select(-watch_seconds) %>% rename(watch_seconds = watch_seconds_calc)
```
## Unique values

```{r}
unique(watch_events_clean$action)
watch_events_clean <- watch_events_clean %>%
  mutate(
    action = factor(
      action,
      levels = c(
        "skip_immediate",
        "skip_after_partial",
        "exit_platform",
        "watch_full"
      )
    )
  )
```

## Visualizing data


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data=watch_events_clean, aes(x = action, y = watch_seconds))+geom_col()
watch_events_clean %>%
  group_by(action) %>%
  summarise(avg_watch = mean(watch_seconds, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = action, y = avg_watch)) +
  geom_col(fill = "orange") + labs(title = "Average Watch Time by Action", x = "Action", y = "Average Watch Time (seconds)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Save plot
path <- here("src", "TikTokdata#10", "data_processed")
ggsave(filename = file.path(path, "average_watch_time_by_action.png"))
```
